item.title: Techno-economic and environmental assessment of next-generation battery-powered farming robots
item.description:
ارزیابی فنی-اقتصادی و زیست‌محیطی ربات‌های کشاورزی باتری‌دار نشان می‌دهد که ارزش آن‌ها بیشتر به کاهش مصرف نهاده و نیروی کار بستگی دارد تا به خود پلتفرم.
Nature Communications | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 This study provides the first integrated total cost of ownership and life cycle assessment of autonomous battery-powered agricultural robots across multiple crops and management systems. It reveals that variable inputs, not platform costs, dominate economic and environmental outcomes, showing robot value hinges on reducing input use and labor demand—offering key guidance for sustainable agricultural automation.
